title: Outbound: how does an owner-approved message reach a prospect?
scope: Owner click on Today through the Vercel app, Postgres, Gmail and the Fly LinkedIn browser worker, plus the refresh cron.
omissions: Prospect finding: scout CLI, YC/HN/GitHub/Exa/Apollo sources
AI research, drafting and the OpenRouter model calls

notes.title: Owner click is the only send
notes.text: sendMessage in lib/engine.ts is the only path that contacts a prospect; crons draft, detect replies and confirm queued LinkedIn actions but never send.

notes.title: Fail-closed pre-send checks
notes.text: Send claims the row (draft|failed→sending), checks 24h limits, re-checks Gmail replies and in-touch status; a failed check sends nothing.

notes.title: Worker exits only via home node
notes.text: Runs stay queued unless Tailscale exit node is online and proxied IP differs from Fly's; a restart mid-run fails it instead of replaying.
